steps.title: Click the child box
steps.text: The child's first listener calls `e.stopImmediatePropagation()`. That stops the event before it reaches the parent, and also skips the child's own second listener, so only `fire child` appears.
steps.textZh: 子方块的第一个监听器调用了 `e.stopImmediatePropagation()`。这会在事件到达父元素之前把它拦下，同时跳过子方块自己的第二个监听器，所以只出现 `fire child`。

steps.title: Click the parent box
steps.text: A click on the parent itself never passes through the child, so the parent's listener runs.
steps.textZh: 直接点在父元素上，事件根本不会经过子元素，所以父元素的监听器会运行。

steps.title: One listener for the whole list
steps.titleZh: 一个监听器管住整个列表
steps.text: The `<ul>` has the only listener in the list. A click on an item bubbles up to it: `event.target` is the `<li>` you clicked, and `event.currentTarget` is the `<ul>` that is listening.
steps.textZh: 列表里只有 `<ul>` 有监听器。点击某一项时，事件冒泡到它：`event.target` 是你点的 `<li>`，`event.currentTarget` 是正在监听的 `<ul>`。

steps.title: stopPropagation is gentler
steps.text: The script also has `e.stopPropagation()`, commented out. It would stop the event before the parent too, but the child's second listener would still run and print `fire child 2nd event`.
steps.textZh: 脚本里还有一行被注释掉的 `e.stopPropagation()`。它同样会在父元素之前拦下事件，但子方块的第二个监听器仍会运行，打印 `fire child 2nd event`。
